name: CATO WREN
bio: A Loom intern's kid who stepped into the Observatory breach in 1997 and walked out of a mountain wall three hours later, the Understitch charted on his arm. He has been crossing ever since and stopped counting in 2019. Nothing is far, only elsewhere.
catchphrase: It is not far. It is just elsewhere.

theme.tagline: Every wall is a door you haven't met.
